title: Failure to obey order, regulation, or rule.
bodyText:
Any person subject to this chapter who:

(1) Violates or fails to obey any lawful general order, regulation, or rule;

(2) Having knowledge of any other lawful order issued by a member of the state military forces, that it is that person's duty to obey, fails to obey the order; or

(3) Is derelict in the performance of that person's duties,

shall be punished as directed by a court-martial.

[§124B-148]  Failure to obey order, regulation, or rule.  Any person subject to this chapter who:

     (1)  Violates or fails to obey any lawful general order, regulation, or rule;

     (2)  Having knowledge of any other lawful order issued by a member of the state military forces, that it is that person's duty to obey, fails to obey the order; or

     (3)  Is derelict in the performance of that person's duties,

shall be punished as directed by a court-martial. [L 2022, c 286, pt of §2]
